HTTP Status Lookup

Look up any HTTP status code — its meaning, class and when servers send it. Search by code or name, filter by class.

–
Codes shown
CodeNameMeaning

📖 How to use

  1. Type a status code or name in the search box.
  2. Or filter by class: 1xx, 2xx, 3xx, 4xx, 5xx.
  3. Read what the code means and when it is used.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What do the status code classes mean?

1xx informational, 2xx success, 3xx redirection, 4xx client error, 5xx server error.

How do I search?

Type the number (e.g. 418) or part of the name (e.g. teapot) — the list filters live.

Are unofficial codes included?

The standard IANA codes plus well-known unofficial ones like 418 I'm a teapot and 419/440/449.

Is this private?

Yes, everything runs locally in your browser.
